quote: Problems and conjectures in rigidity theory, in Mathematics: Frontiers and Perspectives (2000)
note: First posed in Margulis's 2000 paper in the AMS collection Mathematics: Frontiers and Perspectives, pp. 161-174. The conjecture concerns measure classification for higher-rank diagonalizable actions, stating that every invariant ergodic probability measure on a locally homogeneous space is either supported on a lower-dimensional invariant subset or is the natural Haar-type measure.
